repetition_definition: 1 - unique 3-gram count / total 3-gram count, averaged per output
length_scope: average_generated_words_including_prompt counts the prompt and continuation together; continuation-only lengths for the separate saved challenge set are in challenge_continuation_length_metrics.json.
length_threshold_note: A 180-word overlong threshold is above the practical maximum under the 80-new-token generation cap and short prompts; a zero is not informative.
